diagnosis: The check C5 passed in all rollouts because the decision-maker used the default value for 'order_set_required' provided in the pharmacy policy (Fact PF2). This fact was never accessible to the lone decision-maker, as indicated in the decisive_facts structurally_unavailable list. The model defaulted to requiring the order set, which aligns with the policy change described in PF2.

C5.why: The pharmacy policy changes glucose monitoring to every hour for the first four hours and changes the order-set field from optional or unspecified to required.
